cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - DiscRack
cc:Work.dc:description:
A rack for storing disk-shaped objects vertically next to each other
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes DiscRack --sx '10*5 20*3' --disc_diameter 300 --disc_thickness 3 --disc_outset 10 --angle 25 --lower_factor 0.7 --rear_factor 0.8 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes DiscRack --sx --disc_diameter --disc_thickness --disc_outset --angle --lower_factor --rear_factor --thickness --reference --labels
